svg.title: OrgGraph tables and views
svg.desc: Every stored table and SQL view, with all columns. Solid green connects a foreign key. Dashed blue arrows show a view reading a table or another view. Select an object to highlight its direct inputs and outputs.
svg.text: Green = stored table · Blue = calculated view · PK = primary key · FK = foreign key
Solid line = foreign key · Dashed arrow = reads from · Select a card to follow its connections
